unproven_missing_checks.assumption: `python` resolves to a working Python 3 on PATH
unproven_missing_checks.where_required: native/build.ps1:159 runs `python tools/check_legacy_denylist.py` unconditionally on every build, including builds triggered by the owner one-command path
unproven_missing_checks.why_unproven: no Get-Command/python preflight exists anywhere before line 159; the check runs AFTER ~30 compile/link steps, so a clean machine without Python (or with only the Microsoft Store alias stub) burns minutes of compiling then dies with 'python : The term ... is not recognized' or a silent stub exit
unproven_missing_checks.missing_check_example: at the top of build.ps1 next to the vcvars probe: if (-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "Python 3 is required for the legacy denylist gate (native/tools/check_legacy_denylist.py). Install Python 3.x and re-run." }
unproven_missing_checks.severity: blocks the entire owner build path on machines lacking Python

unproven_missing_checks.assumption: script execution policy permits running play-native.ps1
unproven_missing_checks.why_unproven: the documented shortcut Target must smuggle -ExecutionPolicy Bypass (README.md:63); nothing verifies policy, and an owner double-clicking the .ps1 directly gets the editor or a blocked-script dialog; no .cmd shim exists
launcher re-invokes build.ps1 via powershell.exe (play-native.ps1:100); fine on stock Win10/11, unverified on stripped SKUs; pwsh (PowerShell 7) compatibility of Add-Type interop path is untested

unproven_missing_checks.assumption: .NET Framework compiler available to Add-Type in the invoking session
unproven_missing_checks.why_unproven: window-enumeration interop compiles inline C# at runtime (play-native.ps1:200-210); hardened AppLocker/policy machines can disable Add-Type; owner path itself only uses it for selftests/fault-control and the final window close is user-driven, so severity low

unproven_missing_checks.assumption: staleness watcher sees every input that matters
unproven_missing_checks.why_unproven: Test-ExeStale watches only src/, client/, include/ (.cpp/.hpp/.h/.ps1) plus build.ps1 (play-native.ps1:83-92); native/audio/ is compiled into the client (build.ps1:136-139) but is absent from the watch list, so audio source edits leave exes 'fresh' until a manual -Rebuild; config/legacy-denylist.json changes likewise never trigger rebuild
unproven_missing_checks.severity: medium: owner plays stale binaries after audio source edits

negative_control.requirement: identify one clean-machine assumption not proven by the current launcher and show the missing check
negative_control.selection: NC-1: `python` on PATH required by native/build.ps1:159 with zero preflight
negative_control.detail: the legacy denylist gate runs after every compile/link step; on a clean Windows box without Python the owner one-command path spends minutes building then aborts with an unactionable shell error (or trips the Microsoft Store python alias stub); the missing check is a Get-Command python probe with an install-and-retry message placed beside the existing vcvars probe (which already models the correct pattern at build.ps1:43-86)
